Job Description: **Overview**

We are currently hiring for a position focused on screen printing and heat press work. No prior experience is required, making this an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in developing skills in graphic arts, apparel decoration, and visual design. This role offers a hands\-on environment where creativity and attention to detail are valued. The ideal candidate will be eager to learn and contribute to producing high\-quality custom products using various printing techniques.

**Duties**

* Operate screen printing and heat press equipment to produce custom designs on apparel and other materials
* Assist with preparing artwork files for printing, including basic digital design tasks
* Set up and calibrate printing machinery to ensure accurate color matching and placement
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the workspace and equipment
* Inspect finished products for quality assurance, ensuring designs meet client specifications
* Collaborate with team members to complete orders efficiently and on time
* Learn and apply various design principles, including typography, visual arts painting, and graphic design techniques

**Requirements**

* No previous experience necessary; training will be provided on all equipment and processes
* Basic familiarity with digital design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or Adobe InDesign is a plus but not required
* Interest in graphic design, visual arts, or related creative fields is desirable
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality work
* Ability to follow instructions carefully and work as part of a team
* Willingness to learn new skills related to screen printing, heat press operations, and design software
* Good communication skills and a positive attitude toward ongoing professional development

This position provides an excellent entry point into the world of custom apparel production with opportunities to expand your skills in digital design, motion graphics, 3D animation, CAD, fashion design, HTML/CSS, and more. We welcome motivated individuals eager to grow within a creative manufacturing environment.

Pay: From $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

Job Description: **What makes this role important at Ipsos?**

We are looking for someone who is passionate about market research and motivated by a fast\-paced and challenging work environment. This is an excellent entry\-level role for someone who is interested in starting a career in the consulting and insights industry. In this role, you will be responsible for servicing Financial Services Clients (Banks, Credit Unions, Credit Card Companies, etc.) leveraging some of the largest syndicated banking behaviour tracking studies in Canada.  



As a Research Analyst, you will support the Account Lead and senior team members as they work with these clients to understand their business issues and execute customized research projects to meet their needs. You will support projects from start to finish, including designing analytical plans with senior team members, extracting data through different software, analyzing said data to generate insights, assisting in developing recommendations, and creating compelling stories and presentations that help illuminate the human behaviors behind the data. You will also be responsible for ensuring the studies run smoothly from an operational standpoint. The Research Analyst will report to the Director and join a team of curious\-minded researchers and client partners.  



**What you can expect to be doing:**

* Understand and address business needs/issues of respective clients.
* Manage multiple survey\-based market research projects at once, within timeline, including working closely with other team members and colleagues
* Design plan analyses.
* Analyze data and draw conclusions; prepare reports and presentations; make recommendations based on the insights that address the client’s business needs.
* Quality check study questionnaires \& perform in\-depth quality checks at every stage of the process
* Liaising with our internal data collection teams, coding \& data processing teams
* Perform data verification
* Identify and solve project issues as they arise

**This might be the job for you if you have:**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Project management and/or market research experience an asset
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problem solving, critical thinking and analytical skills
* Must be self\-motivated and entrepreneurial (i.e., ability to think independently).
* Intellectually curious with a desire to better understand the “why” behind the data.
* Works well in a team environment with senior and junior colleagues.
* Proactive, “can do” attitude
* High attention to detail: ability to balance overall project goal with key milestones and tasks
* Advanced proficiency with MS Office Suite; specifically, PowerPoint and Excel
* Self\-starter with superior organization skills who thrives in a deadline driven environment
* Ability to juggle multiple projects and diplomatically respond to conflicting needs
* Bilingual an asset,but not required.

*If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to!*

**What’s in it for you:**

*At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture.*

*To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit:* Why Work at Ipsos \| CA  



**Commitment to Diversity**

Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do.
